messages:
maya: Heads-up — deploy window opens in 10m. I'm going to kick off the preflight checks and pin the new runtime. Please ack if you have any hot items to hold back.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @maya for service=router-v2, strategy=canary, canary_pct=5, rollout_duration=30m. Status: queued. :rocket:

samir: ACK. I'll watch SLO dashboards (p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache hit) and hold the roll if p95 > 1200ms or 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m.

maya: thx. ops checklist I'm running: prefix-cache GC check, routing table diff, model-variant mapping sanity. Dropping snippet of the quick checks I run locally:

```bash
# quick smoke queries
curl -sS $SLO_DASH/api/v1/query?query=p95_latency
curl -sS $SLO_DASH/api/v1/query?query=rate(5xx[1m])
# kv cache probe
python tools/probe_kvcache.py --route embed --reads 50
```

ops-runner-bot: Preflight results: p95_latency=450ms, 5xx_rate=0.03%, kv_cache_hit=87%. All green.

tanya: Noted. Two small caveats: embeddings route had a brief spike earlier today (~0.9%) but it recovered; I've left a sticky note on the rollout config to keep embeddings on shadow routing until 50% traffic.

liam: If we see p95 tail increase on the canary, let's not immediately rollback — prefer shrinking canary pct -> 0.5% and re-evaluating for 10m. Rollback only if 5xx bursts or errorbudget breaches.

samir: Agreed. Also monitoring for anomalous auth failures from edge cert rotation (seen once last week). If auth errors show up, we pause and check certchain.

maya: deploy-bot, when you kick, please pin version label to commit: 9f3b2c4 and create a release note draft. include the kb link: https://console.internal/release/notes/9f3b2c4

deploy-bot: Commit pinned: 9f3b2c4. Release draft created: https://console.internal/releases/9f3b2c4. Canary traffic shifting to 5% in 2m.

ops-runner-bot: Live telemetry snapshot at canary start: p95=460ms, p50=120ms, 5xx=0.04%, circuit_trips=0.

samir: Watching dashboards now. If I see a sustained p95 > 1100ms for the canary cohort, I'll post a hold and propose rollback.

maya: Quick reminder for oncall: if any alerts fire, tag @oncall-sre and paste the minimal triage: metric, region, sample trace link. Saves time.

tanya: one more — please monitor long tail of KV cache latency. If kv tail > 10ms at 95th, prefer reducing batch sizes for that route.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at +3m. No automated alerts.

liam: +1 on gradual shrink vs full rollback. Also, if we detect downstream ratelimit 429 clusters, route fallback to alt-region. We have region_fallback policy in the rollout config.

maya: thanks team. I'll leave this thread pinned on the release note and update after 15m. If no holds, we'll plan gradual ramp to 30% at +15m.

ops-runner-bot: 15m snapshot pending. Current: p95=480ms, 5xx=0.05%, kv_cache_hit=86%. No anomalies. :white_check_mark:

samir: thumbs up. continuing to eyeball traces for request patterns.

maya: Update — no holds. Proceeding to ramp to 30% per the schedule. Notify if any smoke.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramp to 30% initiated. Canary->stable transition scheduled in 30m if metrics remain within thresholds.

liam: If 5xx creeps above 0.2% during ramp, auto-stepdown to previous canary pct and alert cascade.

maya: copying that rule into the release draft and closing for now. Will post final commit once stable. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
